newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Friday that around 1,500 head were exported into the United States at one crossing point Thursday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,500 head were sold in active trade. No trned market prices were available.
"Around 90 percent of cattle crossed consisted of one lot of previously contracted yearlings weighing 600-625 lb. Calf market was very slow as most ranches have adequate pasture," USDA said.
